title: Fast Travel Companion Protocol
description: Cross-platform JSON contract for the fast-travel local-search companion daemon. All HTTP endpoints live under /v1 on 127.0.0.1. Named types in $defs are the authoritative source of truth for the Go companion, browser extension (TypeScript), and Android app (Kotlin).

Capabilities.description: Feature flags for an indexer. All fields are required booleans.

booleanOps.description: Supports OR / NOT natively at the indexer level.

pathScope.description: Can scope a query to a specific path or path prefix.

content.description: Supports full-text content search (not just file name).

IndexerInfo.description: Describes one search indexer available on the host.

id.description: Stable machine id. Well-known values: baloo, tracker, plocate, wsearch, everything, mediastore.

available.description: Whether the indexer is installed and its daemon/service is reachable.

PingResponse.description: Response from GET /v1/ping. Always returned without authentication.

version.description: Semver version of the companion binary, e.g. "1.0.0".

protocolVersion.description: Protocol schema version. Starts at 1. The extension enforces a minimum and refuses older companions.

os.description: Operating system of the host running the companion. Android reports "linux" (Android runs on Linux kernel).

paired.description: Whether the calling client has a valid pairing token.

pairingOpen.description: Whether the companion's pairing window is currently open and accepting new pairs.

defaultIndexer.description: Id of the indexer used by default for search requests.

indexers.description: All indexers discovered on this host, available or not.

PairRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/pair. Requires the pairing window to be open.

clientName.description: Human-readable name for the client, e.g. "Fast Travel (Chrome)".

token.description: Bearer token to include in subsequent authenticated requests.

DateRange.description: Inclusive date range in epoch milliseconds. Omitting a bound leaves that end open.

from.description: Start of range (epoch ms, inclusive). Omit for open start.

to.description: End of range (epoch ms, inclusive). Omit for open end.

Filters.description: Optional filters applied server-side before pagination. All fields are optional.

types.description: Restrict results to these file-type categories.

createdRange.description: Restrict to files created within this range.

modifiedRange.description: Restrict to files last modified within this range.

pathPrefix.description: Restrict results to files whose absolute path starts with this prefix.

titleOnly.description: When true, match the file name only; ignore path and content fields.

content.description: When true, include content matches. Only honoured when the active indexer's capabilities.content is true.

SearchRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/search. Requires Bearer token.

query.description: Raw user query in the mini-syntax (see README §2).

queryMode.description: Parsing mode. simple: wildcards are literals. wildcard: * and ? are globs. regex: query is a regex; no AND/OR/NOT tokenization.

history.description: Optional list of recently opened result ids (FileResult.id). The companion may boost these for recency re-ranking.

FileType.description: Broad file-type category used in FileResult.type and Filters.types.

FileResult.description: A single file match returned by /v1/search. FileResult.id is the absolute path of the file. Implementations that cannot guarantee a stable absolute path may use a deterministic hash of it, but must document the choice.

id.description: Stable result id. Canonical choice is the absolute path (e.g. /home/alice/docs/report.pdf). If using a hash, document the hash function.

path.description: Absolute path to the file, e.g. "/home/alice/docs/report.pdf".

dir.description: Absolute path to the parent directory, e.g. "/home/alice/docs".

ext.description: Lowercase file extension without the leading dot, e.g. "pdf". Empty string for files with no extension.

mime.description: Best-effort MIME type, e.g. "application/pdf". Empty string when unknown.

size.description: File size in bytes. 0 for folders.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in epoch milliseconds. 0 when the platform does not expose ctime.

modifiedAt.description: Last-modified timestamp in epoch milliseconds. 0 when unknown.

score.description: Ranking score assigned by the indexer. Higher is better. Not comparable across indexers.

iconHint.description: Optional extra hint for icon selection, e.g. a MIME type or Android app package id.

total.description: Total number of matches before pagination.

page.description: Zero-based page number of this response.

tookMs.description: Time taken to produce this response, in milliseconds.

indexer.description: Id of the indexer that served this query. May differ from PingResponse.defaultIndexer when the companion routed a regex query to a capable fallback.

degraded.description: Optional. True when the requested query mode could not be served natively; results were filtered over a candidate set rather than the full index.

OpenRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/open. Requires Bearer token.

path.description: Absolute path of the file or folder to open.

reveal.description: Optional. When true, reveal the item in the file manager instead of opening it directly.

ErrorResponse.description: Error response returned by any endpoint on failure. HTTP status codes: unauthorized=401, pairing_closed=403, bad_request=400, indexer_unavailable=503, unsupported_mode=422, internal=500.

AstNode.description: A node in the parsed query AST. Produced by parsing a SearchRequest.query string under the mini-syntax rules (see README §2). The AST is the normalized, canonical representation used by all three implementations.

oneOf.description: Logical AND: all child nodes must match. Children are flattened (no nested ands).
Logical OR: at least one child node must match. AND binds tighter: 'a b OR c d' parses as (a AND b) OR (c AND d).
Logical NOT: the child node must not match. Produced by a leading - or ! on a term.
A single term matched against a field. In wildcard mode, wildcard:true if the value contains * or ?. In simple mode, wildcard is always false.

field.description: Field to match against. path: prefix in the query sets this to "path".

value.description: The term string (with path: prefix stripped).

wildcard.description: True only in wildcard mode when the value contains * or ?.

oneOf.description: A quoted phrase matched as a contiguous sequence of words against a field.
A regular expression (regex mode only). No AND/OR/NOT tokenization occurs; the entire query string is the regex value.

field.description: "path" when query starts with path:, otherwise "name".

value.description: The regex string (with path: prefix stripped if present).
